name: jr2-e2e-model-instance
description: The @model tier's instance (ADR-0066): the @kind instance's shape with a REAL model endpoint behind the Custodian. `model-endpoint.json` is materialized per run from `features/model-endpoints/<name>.json` by the fixture (World.setupModel) and is gitignored; it ships in the image so the in-cluster Orchestrator reads what the host did.
